blocks.text: You can choose to delete or offboard AWS, Microsoft Entra, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) accounts when the resources are removed from the accounts or when you no longer want AI Security to scan the resources in these accounts.

blocks.item: All the resources within the account are deleted.
The delete action cannot be reverted. You must onboard the cloud account again if it must be scanned.
Deleting the account does not delete resources created while deploying templates. You must manually delete these resources. To delete the resources, run the terraform destroy command.

blocks.text: Deleting or offboarding cloud accounts impacts the following modules:

table: The account is removed from the Accounts tab.
All issues generated for the deleted account are closed. You cannot filter the issues for the deleted account.
If the deleted account was the only account defined for the filter scope, then the alert rule or ignore alert filter is disabled with an exclamation mark indicating that it is invalid.
If the deleted account was the only account selected for scanning, then the scan configuration is disabled.
The deleted account is not shown while creating custom policies. Any existing custom policy created for the deleted account is marked as invalid.

blocks.text: You must be assigned either an Administrator role or any role with Delete Account permissions.
To delete an organization or tenant:

blocks.item: Select the cloud account you want to delete.
From the Manage drop-down menu, select Delete Organization or Delete Tenant depending on the cloud type.
Read the message in the confirmation window, type DELETE, and then click DELETE.
The organization or tenant and all associated accounts are deleted from the AI Security Admin Portal.

blocks.text: When you delete either a single account or multiple accounts, it is only deleted from the [[variable: ai-security-admin-portal]] and there is no impact on these accounts on the cloud service provider.

blocks.item: In the parent cloud account, select Accounts for AWS, Subscriptions for Microsoft Entra, and Projects for GCP.
For a single account, subscription, or project
Click the Actions icon for the account, subscription, or project you want to delete.
Select Delete Account, Delete Subscription, or Delete Project.
For multiple accounts, subscriptions, or projects
Select the checkboxes for the required accounts, subscriptions, or projects.
From the Actions drop-down menu that appears, select Delete Accounts, Delete Subscriptions, or Delete Projects.
Read the message in the confirmation window, type DELETE, and then click DELETE.

blocks.text: The account is deleted from the AI Security Admin Portal.
